CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Amazon Supply Chain Services gives businesses of all types and sizes access to the freight, distribution, fulfillment, and parcel shipping capabilities Amazon has built, refined, and proven at scale over decades, supporting Amazon sellers and other businesses regardless of where they sell. By extending the global infrastructure, technology, and operational expertise behind Amazon's own supply chain, ASCS helps businesses improve performance, reduce complexity, and operate more efficiently.
